purpose: Training-only physical representation qualification, not posterior calibration or training authorization
selection: All 16 cap/shell/support strata, ordinal 00, both owned cores; 32 pairs and 64 cores total
reference: Independent native full-box R7 spectral tensor, averaged with the same cubic sampling operator; diagonal trace equals sampled smoothed density
baseline: Each separate 48-cubed fine parent alone, isotropic local-DC closure
primary_metric: For each ordered eigenvalue, per-core 1 - candidate_eigen_RMSE / parent_only_eigen_RMSE
other_registered_context_translations: Report the same errors and phase medians as diagnostics; do not pool them into or replace the zero-offset primary gate
threshold_origin: Retain the previous consistent-expanded-density-v2 pilot requirement of 25 percent median improvement over parent-only reconstruction; add phasewise non-regression
failure_policy: Preserve failed evidence; no retrospective threshold change, no scientific model training
